title: Logos 17 opening: what is the Son’s by nature is not the creature’s
english: Seventeenth discourse. That nothing belonging to the Son by nature belongs to the creature by nature; all of that is the Father’s own as well.
Creature gifts vs natural divine properties.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Condensed lemma-led tip.
No Greystone wording. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
